corrections: Derived root-cause fix for the non-finishing previous run: the controller used event guards that depended directly on continuously recomputed expressions involving the same wait timing state and mode dispatch, which can re-trigger near state boundaries. This revision introduces explicit Boolean guard variables for phase-completion conditions and keeps every read of a variable written by the when-algorithm behind pre(...) where previous-event values are intended.
